critical_section: Acquire exclusive Linux process-identity lock once
Reverify matching lock record, inode, process boot ID/start ticks
Under that exact lock: read and validate complete JSONL hash chain
Under that lock: verify externally pinned checkpoint signature, ancestry and sequence
Under same lock: compare caller expected head and sequence, reject stale intervening writes
Under same lock: re-read ledger, append one event and fsync file and directory
Under same lock: read entire chain back, check committed record, revalidate lock identity, then release
tests_scope: Dual writer exclusion, stale count/head, competing prior writer
Valid-but-truncated journal, malformed JSON, torn tail, duplicate replay
Checkpoint digest substitution, signature forgery, absent external custody
Orphan lock fail-closed, guard path mismatch, metadata tampering, inode replacement
Accepted documentary append retains physical ACT HOLD
remaining_limits: No actual independently authenticated external checkpoint, issuer or hardware has been supplied
Caller-provided policy authentication booleans remain assertions; not externally proven
OS lock and path checks on mutable local directories are not a full hostile-filesystem security boundary
Independent remote readback/atomic external custody commitment not yet implemented
Crash may leave torn tail which must be adjudicated; no automatic lock takeover or repair
Native Rust compilation, CI and live Pages execution have not been independently verified
